title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid
description: Calculate minimum insertions to make parentheses string valid by tracking balance.
pseudocode:
1. open = 0, add = 0
2. for char in s:
3.   if char == '(': open++
4.   else if open > 0: open--
5.   else: add++
6. return open + add

steps.note: Initialize open and add counters to 0
Found ')', decrement open balance as it matches '(', open becomes 0
Found ')', no open parenthesis to match, increment add
